age.evidence: Eight- to 10-wk old control and MIA offspring

sex.evidence: Only male offspring were tested to avoid the effects of ovarian hormones on female behavior.

dosing.evidence: Eight- to 10-wk old control and MIA offspring received ( ± )DOI hydrochloride (1 or 2 mg/kg, i.p.) (Sigma) or saline.

handling.evidence: Handling protocol not described in methods.

group_housing.evidence: males were caged in groups of two to four.

day_night_flipped.evidence: All behavioral tests were conducted between 900 and 1700 h during the light phase of the circadian cycle.

enrichment_housing.evidence: housed under standard laboratory conditions; enrichment not specified.

assays.assay_description: Mice injected i.p. with DOI (1 or 2 mg/kg) or saline; head twitches counted manually in the home cage for 30 min by an experimenter blind to treatment. Includes variants with chronic ketanserin pretreatment and MnCl2 pretreatment.

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were single-housed and moved to a quiet testing room 24 h before injection, but no apparatus habituation is described (test is in the home cage).

setup_restrain.evidence: Behavioral responses to the drug or vehicle were recorded in the home cage for 30 min after the injection.

food_restriction.evidence: Test in home cage under standard laboratory conditions; no restriction mentioned.

water_restriction.evidence: Test in home cage under standard laboratory conditions; no restriction mentioned.

time_to_assay.evidence: Behavioral responses to the drug or vehicle were recorded in the home cage for 30 min after the injection.

sample_size.evidence: n = 9 -13 from three to four litters per group

outcomes.summary: DOI induced head twitches in a dose-dependent manner in both groups, but MIA offspring displayed significantly more head twitches than controls at both 1 and 2 mg/kg. Chronic ketanserin pretreatment reduced DOI-induced head twitching in MIA offspring but had no effect in controls.
outcomes.evidence: compared with controls, MIA offspring display a significantly greater response [for 1 mg/kg DOI, F (1, 28) = 3.884, P = 0.059; post hoc test, P < 0.05; for 2 mg/kg DOI, F (1, 33) = 3.56, P = 0.068; post hoc test, P < 0.01].

B1_num_measures.evidence: Head twitches were defined as rapid radial movements of the head and were counted by an experimenter blind to the treatment group.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total count over 30 min reported; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Head twitches counted as discrete events; no sequence analysis.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Twenty-four hours before injection, the animals were single housed.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate pharmacological response, no learning component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: counted by an experimenter blind to the treatment group.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate analysis (ANOVA on head twitch counts) only.

E1_environment_type.evidence: Behavioral responses to the drug or vehicle were recorded in the home cage for 30 min after the injection.

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter described in home cage during recording.

E3_bedding.evidence: Standard home cage testing — bedding is part of standard home cage.

E6_spatial.evidence: Standard home cage is a single compartment.

E7_social_context.evidence: Twenty-four hours before injection, the animals were single housed.

E8_food_water.evidence: Recording in home cage with standard food/water access.

D1_continuity.evidence: recorded in the home cage for 30 min after the injection.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Single behavioural test day per animal.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline recording for HTR.

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay was scored: the Head Twitch Response. The MEMRI imaging is a neural activity readout (not behaviour) and was excluded per rubric. qRT-PCR for IEGs and 5-HT2AR signaling molecules are molecular endpoints, also excluded. PPI is mentioned only in Fig. S3 reference and is not described in the main methods; not scored as a separate assay.
Merged candidate variants (DOI alone, DOI+ketanserin, DOI+MnCl2) into one HTR assay per rubric (same paradigm under different pharmacological manipulations = 1 assay).

E3 bedding scored Yes (standard home cage testing implies bedding); E8 food/water Yes (home-cage test with standard ad lib access). GLM also scored E2 shelter as Yes based on 'home cage' but home cage shelter not explicitly described — kept as No with low confidence.
setup_habituation marked not_reported: animals were moved to a testing room and single-housed 24h prior, but apparatus (home cage) habituation is not separate exposure.
